summary: Russia launched a massive combined strike on Ukraine using ballistic missiles, 8 Kalibr, 6 Kh-59/69 missiles, and 129 UAVs targeting Odesa region infrastructure, while Ukraine struck Russian regions with 230 aircraft-type UAVs intercepted across 12 regions. sections.executive_summary: Russia executed a large-scale combined missile and UAV strike across Ukraine, focusing on Odesa's port infrastructure and metallurgical plants in Zaporizhzhia, Dnipropetrovsk, and Kryvyi Rih, while Ukrainian UAVs penetrated 12 Russian regions causing industrial damage in Samara. Russian ground forces made tactical gains near Novomarkove, Novohryshyne, and Zorivka amid heavy fighting along the eastern front. Ukrainian air defenses intercepted 336 of 410 incoming strike UAVs in a 12-hour window, yet 21 UAVs struck targets and approximately 55 remained active with additional waves inbound. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33196, @kpszsu/77970, @DeepStateUA/23825)
